title: Isolating the lab from the real network

videos.script: An isolated network keeps a lab away from the real network. It does not keep it away from the host, the one computer that holds every guest. {{host}} In this lesson you look at the lab from inside a guest, the way anything running in it would, and list every door that is still open. {{inside}} Then you close them: one firewall rule on the host, no shared folders, no shared clipboard. {{close}} And you run the same check again, from inside, because a door is only closed when it has been tried. {{again}}
